job.title: DIRECT HIRE Physical Therapist Assignment in Sacramento, California with Competitive Compensation Package
job.description:
Clinical Magnet (part of ICON Medical) is hiring a Physical Therapist for a meaningful opportunity supporting the 55+ frail and elderly population in a collaborative, interdisciplinary care model. This role focuses on functional improvement, maintenance therapy, and restorative care within a PACE-style program setting, where continuity of care and patient-centered outcomes are the priority.

This is a DIRECT HIRE OPPORTUNITY

Job Summary:
The Physical Therapist provides comprehensive evaluation, treatment planning, and ongoing therapy services for program participants aged 55 and older. This includes acute, restorative, and maintenance-level care. The PT integrates therapy plans into the physician-directed Plan of Care (POC), collaborates closely with an interdisciplinary team, and ensures all care aligns with InnovAge policies, CMS guidelines, and state regulations. This role also supports durable medical equipment (DME) management, caregiver education, and coordination across care settings.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Perform screenings and comprehensive PT evaluations for acute, restorative, and maintenance needs
  • Develop and implement individualized treatment plans within the interdisciplinary Plan of Care
  • Deliver therapeutic interventions including modalities, exercise, gait training, and functional mobility work
  • Collaborate with nursing facilities, assisted living staff, OT, ST, and medical providers
  • Conduct home visits and caregiver training to support safe mobility and independence
  • Educate participants and caregivers on DME use, safety, and maintenance
  • Manage, order, and maintain durable medical equipment inventory and documentation
  • Delegate appropriate treatment tasks to PTAs and Rehab Aides per state regulations
  • Document all care, progress, and updates in a timely and compliant manner
  • Participate in interdisciplinary team meetings, care planning, and quality initiatives
  • Support staff education and provide guidance to non-rehab team members as needed
  • Ensure compliance with APTA ethics, CMS standards, and state practice laws

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Physical Therapy required (Master's or DPT preferred)
  • Graduate of an APTA-accredited Physical Therapy program
  • Active Physical Therapist license in the practicing state
  • Minimum 1 year experience working with frail or elderly populations required
  • 2+ years of PT experience preferred
  • Experience in home health, outpatient geriatrics, or PACE programs strongly preferred
  • Bilingual skills a plus
  • Strong communication, documentation, and interdisciplinary collaboration skills

Position Overview:
  • Direct hire, stable long-term opportunity
  • Highly collaborative interdisciplinary care environment
  • Focus on geriatric, medically complex, and frail populations
  • Mix of clinic-based, facility-based, and home-based care
  • Strong emphasis on functional outcomes and quality of life

Benefits:
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Continuing education support and professional development opportunities
  • Mileage reimbursement (if applicable to field visits)

This is an outstanding opportunity for an experienced acute care RN who is passionate about teaching, developing others, and driving quality improvement throughout a collaborative hospital environment.

Clinical Magnet, a division of ICON Medical Network, is looking for an experienced and passionate Clinical Nurse Educator to join our partner's full-time team in Morrisville, Vermont.
